evidence.title: fix(core)!: let bash expand project directory variables in command hooks by qqqys · Pull Request #11864 · QwenLM/qwen-code · GitHub

name: fix(core)!: let bash expand project directory variables in command hooks
summary: Merged pull request: bash command hooks in Qwen Code expand project directory variables from the environment instead of by rewrite.
description: Pull request in QwenLM/qwen-code marked breaking: command hooks running under bash receive their command string exactly as configured and bash expands $QWEN_PROJECT_DIR, $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and $GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR from the hook's environment. cmd.exe and PowerShell keep the pre-launch rewrite, which now also covers $QWEN_PROJECT_DIR and ignores longer names. Migration: double-quote the variables in bash hooks.
contains: bash hooks get the command verbatim; variables come from the environment
cmd/PowerShell keep the quoted-path rewrite, extended to $QWEN_PROJECT_DIR with a word boundary
migration: double-quote $QWEN_PROJECT_DIR in bash hooks; single quotes no longer expand
mutation checks cover bash verbatim, rewrite coverage and the word boundary
merged Sep 14, 2026 (commit d401392); Windows shell rework left to #11778
